label: Takeaway
detail: UM-Dearborn went 9-32 and 5-23 in the WHAC as played, up from 1-47 in 2025. Its schedule lists 10-31 and 6-22, because a Mar 30 game lost 9-1 at Rochester Christian was later marked as a forfeit win. No 2027 roster is posted, so by class it keeps 62% of 2026 plate appearances and 61% of innings. Pete Finn coached one season; Rich Robinson is listed as interim head coach for 2027.

label: Method
detail: No 2027 roster is posted. Back means a 2026 player listed as a freshman, sophomore or junior. Listed seniors count as out. Transfers and departures since the season aren't known, so these shares can run high.

label: Season
detail: 9-32 as played followed 1-47 in 2025. UM-Dearborn scored 170 runs and allowed 360, hit .238 and posted an 8.46 ERA. It went 0-10 at home and 9-20 away. The count includes two fall wins at Miami Middletown on Sep 27, 2025, which the school's schedule and NAIA stats both list in the 2026 season.

label: Postseason
detail: UM-Dearborn didn't reach the WHAC Tournament. Its season ended with four losses at Northwestern Ohio on Apr 23-24.

label: lu_proj
detail: Built from 2026 box scores, using only players who can return by class. Each spot goes to the returner with the most 2026 starts there. Order is by 2026 OPS, so small samples rank high. Set means 20 or more starts at the spot, Likely 8 or more.

label: lu_most
detail: A typical 2026 lineup, built from the 39 box scores that list a lineup (the Feb 14 and Feb 28 box scores list none). Each position goes to the player with the most starts there, using each player once and keeping as many of those starts as possible; the DH spot counts only starts at DH. The order is each player's average spot across all his 2026 starts, lowest first. No one started half the games at DH (Swiney, 11) or second (Grunenwald, 12), so those spots were shared. 2027 outlook is the same status used on the rest of this page.

label: lu_all
detail: UM-Dearborn used 38 different lineups in the 39 games whose box score lists one; the Feb 14 and Feb 28 box scores list none. A lineup counts as the same only with the same nine in the same order at the same positions.

label: rot_proj
detail: The same 2026 stats, with projected 2027 roles for pitchers who can return by class. Listed seniors made 17 of the 38 published starts. With no 2027 roster posted, these are role guesses from 2026 usage.

label: Staff
detail: Main starters made at least 4 starts. Relievers made at least 5 relief outings and aren't main starters. GS and Relief are published totals.

label: Maps
detail: 21 of the 31 players with a listed hometown are from Michigan, 7 of them from Wayne County. The rest are spread over Ohio, five other states, Ontario and Alberta.

label: League
detail: UM-Dearborn ranked 11th of 11 WHAC teams in runs per game (4.15) and 11th in on-base percentage (.351). On the mound it ranked 7th in ERA (8.46) and 10th in strikeouts per nine (6.58).

label: Method
detail: wOBA uses standard big-league weights. FIP uses a constant that sets the NAIA-wide FIP equal to NAIA ERA. Rank 1 is best in every row. UM-Dearborn's numbers are from NAIA stats, and its WHAC rank is out of 11 teams because Rochester Christian isn't listed.

label: Filter
detail: All games shows UM-Dearborn's published totals. Any other filter is added up from box scores and play-by-play, game by game. The filter changes the Hitters, Pitchers and Tendencies tabs. Player cards always show the full season.

label: Outing log
detail: Days of rest counts full calendar days since the pitcher's previous appearance, whatever the filter. Pitch counts show a dash when a box score lists none.

label: Max Granatstein
detail: Granatstein, a sophomore shortstop, hit .277 with a .875 OPS and led the team with 6 homers and 23 RBI. He made all 34 of his box-score starts at shortstop and can return by class.

label: Scoring
detail: UM-Dearborn scored 4.15 runs a game in NAIA stats, 11th of 11 in the WHAC and 172nd of 179 in the NAIA. It hit .238 and struck out in 22.9% of plate appearances, both last in the WHAC.

label: League play
detail: UM-Dearborn went 5-23 in the WHAC as played and was outscored 88-265, hitting .207 with a 8.73 ERA in those 28 games. Its wins came against Rochester Christian (two), Siena Heights, Defiance and Cleary. It lost all four to Indiana Tech and Northwestern Ohio.

label: Top of the rotation
detail: Gallardo, a listed senior, threw the most innings (34.1) with a 5.77 ERA. Hesterman, also a senior, had a 6.10 ERA in 31.0. Every returner by class with 20 or more innings had an ERA of 6.55 or higher.

label: Close games
detail: UM-Dearborn went 1-5 in one-run games and 1-14 in games decided by eight or more.

label: Senior losses
detail: Listed seniors had 508 of 1351 plate appearances, led by Forner, Schmitt and Deleruyelle, and 108.2 of 277.0 innings, led by Gallardo, Hesterman and Cardella.

label: Catcher
detail: Gavin Hollon made 20 starts here and was a listed senior. Also: Nathan Deleruyelle 12.

label: First base
detail: Roberto Torres made 21 starts here and can return by class. Also: Carlo Corona 14.

label: Second base
detail: Lance Smith made 12 starts here and can return by class. Also: Jameson Grunenwald 12, Gavin Hampton 9.

label: Shortstop
detail: Max Granatstein made 34 starts here and can return by class.

label: Third base
detail: Beck Kjeldbjerg made 31 starts here and can return by class.

label: Outfield
detail: Darren Pagel 34 starts (back by class), Alex Schmitt 33 starts (listed senior), James Forner 24 starts (listed senior), Connor Swiney 10 starts (back by class).

label: Rotation
detail: Listed seniors made 17 of the 38 published starts: Luis Gallardo 7, Johnny Hesterman 5, Ben Cardella 5. Piesko, Dion and Lemke are back by class.

label: Bullpen
detail: Gavin Hampton 8 relief outings (listed senior), Matt Cheetam 7 relief outings (back by class), Mari Hegenberger-Ellars 7 relief outings (back by class), Cael Bedard 7 relief outings (back by class), Ben Cardella 7 relief outings (listed senior), John Stavola 7 relief outings (back by class), Zack Lemke 6 relief outings (back by class), Kage Little 6 relief outings (back by class), Brady Dion 6 relief outings (back by class).

label: Listed senior hitters, 10 or more at-bats
detail: James Forner, Alex Schmitt, Nathan Deleruyelle, Gavin Hollon, Gavin Hampton, Carlo Corona, Bryce Schwab.

label: Listed senior pitchers, 10 or more innings
detail: Luis Gallardo (34.1 IP), Johnny Hesterman (31.0 IP), Ben Cardella (27.1 IP), Gavin Hampton (14.1 IP).

label: Staff
detail: Rich Robinson, the 2026 pitching coach and recruiting coordinator, is listed as interim head coach for the 2027 season. Pete Finn, hired July 25, 2025, coached 2026 and is no longer on the staff page.

label: 2027 roster
detail: Not published yet, so transfers in and out aren't known.

label: Rich Robinson, interim head coach
detail: Named interim head coach for 2027. He was UM-Dearborn's pitching coach and recruiting coordinator in 2026, and before that head coach at St. Clair County Community College. He also coaches with the Michigan Monarchs of the Great Lakes Summer Collegiate League.

label: Pete Finn, 2026 head coach
detail: Hired July 25, 2025, after a long high school career; his bio lists 496 wins and a 2007 state runner-up finish at Farmington. He went 9-32 as played (10-31 as listed) in his one season and is no longer listed.

label: Ben Cardella
detail: WHAC Champions of Character team.

label: All-WHAC
detail: No UM-Dearborn player made the first or second team, the Gold Glove team or a player award.

label: Where the roster comes from
detail: 21 of 31 list a Michigan hometown, 7 of them in Wayne County near campus. Two list Ohio, two Ontario and one Alberta.

label: How players arrive
detail: From the roster's Hometown/Previous School column, which lists one school: 17 of 31 came straight from high school, 10 from junior colleges and 4 from four-year schools (Spring Arbor, Concordia, Lane and Missouri Valley). St. Clair County CC sent three and Mott CC two.

label: No 2027 roster
detail: UM-Dearborn hasn't published its 2026-27 roster. Every 2027 status here comes from the 2026 class: seniors count as gone and everyone else as able to return.

label: Forfeits recorded as played
detail: Three games at Rochester Christian are marked Forfeit on UM-Dearborn's schedule, because Rochester Christian used an ineligible player. Every record, score and line here uses the game as played. Mar 30 game 1 was lost 9-1 on the field and is listed as a 7-0 win. Apr 21 was won 6-3 on the field and is listed 7-0. Mar 29 game 2 is listed 13-10, the score on the field. That is why the schedule shows 10-31 and 6-22. The Apr 24 recap gives 9-32 (5-23), before the forfeits were entered.

label: Fall games count
detail: The 2026 season on the school's site and NAIA stats includes two fall games at Miami Middletown on Sep 27, 2025. They're in every total here. Jack Clever started the second one and isn't on the spring roster or the published pitching lines.

label: Decisions worked out by elimination
detail: Five decisions aren't in the box scores: losses for Gallardo (Mar 5), Lemke (Mar 22) and Dion (Mar 6), and Dion's win and Bedard's save in the Mar 14 3-1 win at Siena Heights. Each is the only game that brings the pitcher to his published line. Two of Piesko's four losses can't be placed; they fall among 4 games he pitched in.

label: Some games have no real counts
detail: 8 of the 41 box scores have no usable counts, including both games at Siena Heights on Mar 14. Those games are left out of the count and pitch stats.

label: Box score gaps
detail: Box score totals tie to the official lines for at-bats, runs, hits, RBI, walks and strikeouts. Play-by-play is short one triple (Smith), one hit-by-pitch (Smith), one sacrifice (Schmitt) and five steals (Hollon 3, Pagel, Kjeldbjerg). Box score starts give Hesterman and Dion one more start each than their published lines, and hit batters differ by one for Dion and Stavola.

label: Roster
detail: The roster lists one previous school per player, so transfers show no high school. Mike Lemieux is listed as a freshman from St. Clair County CC with no number or position.

label: Map sources
detail: Hometowns are from UM-Dearborn's roster. I entered coordinates by hand, so towns are approximate. Shapes come from U.S. Census and Natural Earth.

label: Checked by arithmetic
detail: The box scores add to 9-32 and 5-23 in WHAC games. Box score batting adds to 170 runs scored and the box scores to 360 allowed, matching the official totals.

label: Box scores are from NAIA stats
detail: All 41 games are on NAIA stats, captured Nov 6, 2026. The two fall games use a different scorer's wording, which was rewritten into the usual form before parsing.

label: Play-by-play gaps
detail: Two box scores have no play-by-play at all: game 2 against Judson on Feb 14 and game 2 at Wilberforce on Feb 28. Their batting and pitching lines are in every total, but they add nothing to the tendency, count and direction numbers. Three other games miss a play or two.

label: Projections
detail: Projected lineups and staffs come from public numbers and class. UM-Dearborn has published no depth chart.

label: Commits
detail: No commit list for UM-Dearborn was checked.

label: Spray charts are partial
detail: Spray charts use 674 of Michigan-Dearborn's 1,081 at-bats (62%): 85% of balls in play, 73% of hits (190 of 259) and 91% of everything else (484 of 532). Strikeouts have no direction. Scorers skip the direction on hits far more often than on outs, so charts can understate hits. Zones are where the scorer placed the ball, not exact spots.

label: Direction corrected
detail: Double plays were being credited to the relay throw instead of the first fielder, and plays written with the last name first or an error by a fielder had no direction. I corrected that on Nov 4, which moved Pull, Center and Oppo a few points for some hitters and raised the direction counts.

detail: Conference previews plus a Top 25 table with rank, last record and last final rank.
extra: Overview: last season and preseason context up front

detail: Each team lists transfers and high school recruits by tier, then explains fit.
extra: Recruiting tab: newcomers by route, with fit notes

detail: Returning starters, starting pitching, relievers and newcomers with prior school, then a short outlook.

label: EvanMiya college basketball
detail: Share of minutes from returners. Returner-reliant teams beat expectations far more often than newcomer-reliant ones.

label: Runs by inning
detail: UM-Dearborn scored most in the 5th (33 runs) and 19 in the 1st. It scored 44 from the 7th on, though 7-inning games shorten that count.

label: Runs allowed
detail: Opponents scored most in the 1st, 75 runs, and 187 in the first three innings.

label: Steals
detail: Play-by-play shows 36 steals of second, 6 of third and 1 of home, of 48 published.

label: Where Cleary has the edge
detail: Batting average .320 to .238, on-base percentage .433 to .351, slugging .453 to .324, OPS .886 to .675, wOBA .393 to .312, runs per game 7.69 to 4.15, homers per game 0.40 to 0.39, steals per game 1.44 to 1.17, walk rate 13.4% to 11.5%, strikeout rate 14.1% to 22.9%, ERA 5.70 to 8.46, FIP 6.11 to 7.14, WHIP 1.58 to 2.07, strikeouts per nine 8.53 to 6.58, walks plus hit batters per nine 7.29 to 8.90, homers allowed per nine 0.56 to 0.60, fielding percentage .968 to .931.

label: Series
detail: The teams split at Howell on Apr 19, UM-Dearborn winning 10-9 and Cleary 11-0. Since 2019 Cleary leads 15-5, counting two fall games each in 2019 and 2023.

label: Apr 19: UM-Dearborn 10, Cleary 9
detail: Piesko started for UM-Dearborn (4.0 IP, 6 ER) and Parris for Cleary (3.2 IP, 6 ER). Swiney went 3-for-4 for UM-Dearborn, and Seman went 2-for-3 for Cleary.

label: Apr 19: Cleary 11, UM-Dearborn 0
detail: Greene started for UM-Dearborn (3.0 IP, 2 ER) and Lieng for Cleary (5.0 IP, 0 ER). Bellomo went 1-for-2 for UM-Dearborn, and Kempainen went 2-for-3 for Cleary.

label: Method
detail: With All games selected, every number in this view counts all 41 games, from box scores and play-by-play. Ground outs include sacrifices and fielder's choices, and air outs include sacrifice flies.

label: Partial
detail: Scorers didn't enter these details for every game, so each number covers only part of the season. Treat them as samples. The first two tables show what's missing.

label: Splits
detail: Innings and time through the order use every plate appearance. Time through the order is each pitcher's batters faced in that game divided by nine, so substitutions can shift it slightly.

label: Splits
detail: Only plate appearances with a count listed. The count is where the plate appearance stood before its final pitch. Two strikes and Full count overlap the other rows.

label: Ground and air outs
detail: Forner has 1.88 ground outs per air out, the most among regulars (90 or more plate appearances), and Kjeldbjerg has 0.51.

label: How long arms go
detail: Gallardo averages 4.8 innings a start, Greene 4.2 and Dion 3.8. Piesko averages 2.8.

label: Groundball and fly-ball arms
detail: Greene has 1.57 ground outs per air out, the most among pitchers with 100 batters faced, and Piesko has 0.50.

label: First-pitch swings
detail: Among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, Forner swings at the most first pitches, 38% on 98. Pagel swings at the fewest, 25% on 107.

label: Swing and miss
detail: Kjeldbjerg whiffs on 18% of swings, the fewest among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, and Schmitt on 33%.

label: Direction
detail: Pagel pulls 57% of his batted balls, the most among regulars, on 72 with a direction. Granatstein pulls 25%, on 93.

label: Pitch counts
detail: Greene averages 84 pitches a start and Gallardo 79. Greene's most was 105. Averages use only outings with a listed count.
